incident-bot: SEV2: policy-engine runtime panic during smart-routing evaluation. Auto-paging on-call.

hana: getting alerts: sudden spike in 5xx and retries starting 2026-03-15T12:12:25Z. traces show policy-eval panics and customers seeing request failures.

pagerduty: Page acknowledged by omar (on-call).

omar: on it. can someone drop a quick summary of recent policy deploys?

trish: deployed smart-routing v2026-03-15-11:58 (small rewrite of weight assignment). The change introduced a helper call `regionPriority(req.region)` inside a rule expression. The helper returns nil for unknown regions, not an int.

ken: logs: ```
2026-03-15T12:12:27Z policy-engine ERROR eval: unexpected nil in numeric context
2026-03-15T12:12:27Z policy-engine panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference

goroutine 45 [running]:
main.(*Evaluator).evalBinaryOp(0xc0002d6000, 0x7f, 0x1)
\t/go/src/redwood/policy/eval.go:512 +0x2d3
```

hana: OK looks like evaluator tried to treat nil as number. that caused a panic and the service crashed for a subset of instances, triggering fallback loops.

omar: immediate mitigations: 1) place policy-engine pool into maintenance so new decisions return PASS-THROUGH 2) revert smart-routing policy to last-known-good 3) enable instance-level restart to flush bad state. who can run the maintenance toggle?

trish: I can toggle maintenance via control-plane. doing maintenance toggle now.

trish: control-plane CLI: ```bash
redwood control policy-engine set-maintenance --env prod --enable true --reason "panic on nil helper return"
```

incident-bot: CONTROL PLANE: maintenance enabled for policy-engine in prod. Some requests will bypass smart-routing until release is reverted.

ken: after maintenance enabled, we see panics stop on the hot cluster, but a few older instances still crashing due to in-flight evaluations. Restarting pods in the canary group now.

omar: good. trish, can you revert policy? specify the rule disabled or full revert?

trish: reverting the single rule that calls helper. patch shown below to disable rule "weighted-region-fn":
```json
{ "op": "patch", "path": "/rules/weighted-region-fn/enabled", "value": false }
```

trish: patch applied and accepted by control plane, propagation reported within 20s.

marc-cs: CS update: two EU customers reported elevated failures and retries, one opened a P1 ticket. They're asking for mitigation ETA.

omar: ETA: immediate mitigation done (maintenance + revert). estimating full recovery within 5-10 mins while restarts complete. sharing message with customers.

marc-cs: message to customers drafted: "We've reverted a recent routing change and enabled a safe-mode; services should return to normal within minutes. We will follow up with a detailed postmortem." 

ken: observed tail-end errors clearing. p95 latency for affected routes dropping from ~1.1s -> 240ms. 5xx rate trending to baseline. no new panics logged in last 3 min.

omar: root cause hypothesis: helper function could return nil for unknown region values; our DSL/evaluator lacks a safe conversion path and had no guard against nil in arithmetic contexts. parser allowed the expression and CI didn't catch it because unit tests didn't exercise unknown-region path.

hana: action items: 1) emergency: add runtime guard that converts nil->0 for numeric ops and logs a parse-eval warning (ken). 2) policy CI: require symbolic/fuzz tests that exercise helper outputs including unknowns (trish). 3) control plane: add canary parsing step that simulates random region inputs before promotion (omar). 4) customer: follow up and offer call for the impacted accounts (marc-cs).

ken: I'll open an MR with a small evaluator patch to short-circuit numeric op when operand is nil and emit metric `policy.eval.nil-operand`. will also add alert to page on that metric.

trish: also adding pre-merge step in policy repo that runs a lightweight emulator with random region strings. doc note about helper contracts.

omar: keep maintenance enabled until we confirm no regressions in next 30m. I'll watch.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 2026-03-15T12:22:00Z. Please create postmortem and tag #policy-null-deref.

hana: creating postmortem. owners: hana (write), trish (policy tests), ken (runtime guard), omar (canary safety).

marc-cs: customers notified; one customer asked for a short RCA and timeline. will coordinate postmortem distribution.

omar: thanks team. quick, clean mitigation. let's follow up with the longer fixes and add more defensive tests. :thumbsup:

trish (later): policy CI now includes fuzzer test that found another edge-case where helper returned empty-string -> attempted cast to int. fixed and docs updated.

ken (later): runtime guard MR merged, will roll to canary tomorrow as part of routine deploy. metrics and alerting in place.

incident-bot: Reminder: file postmortem in /incidents/postmortems and mark severity and customer impact.
